extracted.name: Russian Cheese Salad
extracted.description: This cheese salad recipe was the favorite of the Russian dishes served at our wedding. It's simple, tangy, and can be used as more than a side dish. Serve on top of bread or crackers.
instruction_lines: Stir mozzarella cheese, mayonnaise, and garlic together in a bowl. Chill in the refrigerator until serving.
